sc4_definition: ab4/spec_v2: m_id = s1_id - s2_id (gap between top-1 and top-2 identity scores, identity-level max-pool). Also saved: s1_img, s2_img_same_id within predicted identity for transparency.

score_definitions.Sc2_MSP: max softmax probability over 145 identity scores at T* (argmin E-AURC on calib)
score_definitions.Sc3_energy: T*logsumexp(s/T*) (higher=more confident), T* argmin E-AURC on calib
